name: Update Groups Members
description: Update the list of users for a User Group. [See the documentation](https://api.slack.com/methods/usergroups.users.update)

configurable_props.name: userGroup
configurable_props.label: User Group
configurable_props.description: The encoded ID of the User Group.

configurable_props.name: usersToAdd
configurable_props.label: Users to Add
configurable_props.description: A list of encoded user IDs that represent the users to add to the group.

configurable_props.name: usersToRemove
configurable_props.label: Users to Remove
configurable_props.description: A list of encoded user IDs that represent the users to remove from the group.

configurable_props.name: team
configurable_props.label: Team
configurable_props.description: Encoded team id where the user group exists, required if org token is used.
